entities.summary: Augusto "Gus" Binelli is a retired Italian professional basketball player and coach. At a height of 2.15 m tall, and a weight of 118 kg (260 lb), he played at the center position. Binelli was drafted in the second round, of the 1986 NBA draft, by the Atlanta Hawks, though he never played in the NBA. The Hawks still own his draft rights, as of December 2024.
